references.text: Nahor and his wife Milcah are mentioned here, providing the background for the genealogy leading to Rebekah.
The introduction to the genealogy listing the eight sons Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
Rebekah is introduced as the daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah and Nahor, becoming a central figure in the story of Isaac's marriage.
Rebekah identifies herself as the daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah and Nahor, thus confirming her family lineage.
Abraham's servant confirms Rebekah's family background as the daughter of Bethuel, son of Nahor and Milcah.
Rebekah is described as the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-Aram and sister of Laban at her marriage to Isaac.
